AS(VALUES(2019),(2018)), rec(product_id,kind,mode,y,n,mn,pq,ending,pre) AS (SELECT s.product_id,s.kind,m.mode,y.y,0,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.init,s.init FROM seeds s CROSS JOIN modes m CROSS JOIN demand_year y UNION ALL SELECT r.product_id,r.kind,r.mode,r.y,r.n+1,r.mn,r.pq,CASE r.mode WHEN 'immediate_add' THEN r.ending-b.qty+CASE WHEN r.ending-b.qty<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE 0 END WHEN END,r.ending-b.qty FROM rec r JOIN monthly_budget b ON r.product_id=b.product_id AND b.mth=printf('%d-%02d-01',r.y,r.n+1) WHERE n<12), allmetric AS(SELECT *,ABS(ending-mn) diff,'post' metric FROM rec WHERE n>0 UNION ALL SELECT *,ABS(pre-mn),'pre' FROM rec WHERE n>0), ranked AS(SELECT *,MIN(diff) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric) mindiff FROM allmetric) SELECT product_id,kind,mode,y,metric,mindiff,GROUP_CONCAT(n) months FROM ranked WHERE diff=mindiff GROUP BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric ORDER BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric

WITH RECURSIVE
init AS (
  SELECT pm.product_id, it.qty AS inv, pm.qty_minimum AS mn, pm.qty_purchase AS pq
  FROM product_minimums pm
  JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id) it
    ON it.product_id = pm.product_id
),
rec(product_id, mth, ending, mn, pq) AS (
  SELECT i.product_id, mb.mth,
         CASE WHEN i.inv - mb.qty < i.mn THEN i.inv - mb.qty + i.pq ELSE i.inv - mb.qty END,
         i.mn, i.pq
  FROM init i
  JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = i.product_id AND mb.mth = '2019-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.product_id, date(r.mth, '+1 month'),
         CASE WHEN r.ending - mb.qty < r.mn THEN r.ending - mb.qty + r.pq ELSE r.ending - mb.qty END,
         r.mn, r.pq
  FROM rec r
  JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = r.product_id AND mb.mth = date(r.mth, '+1 month')
  WHERE r.mth < '2019-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT r.product_id,
         r.mth AS "month",
         ABS(r.ending - r.mn) AS abs_diff,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.product_id ORDER BY ABS(r.ending - r.mn) ASC, r.mth ASC) AS rn
  FROM rec r
)
SELECT product_id, "month", abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id;
